Title: Why You Should Start Work at 10am
Elementary: Many of us know we don’t get enough sleep, but imagine if there was a simple solution: getting up later. In a speech at the British Science Festival, Dr. Paul Kelley from Oxford University said schools should stagger their starting times to work with the natural rhythms of their students. This would improve exam results and students’ health (lack of sleep can cause diabetes, depression, obesity and other health problems).

It would improve cognitive performance, exam results and students’ health (lack of sleep can cause diabetes, depression, obesity and immune system problems).
